definitions.explanation: An unmanned vehicle or device sent to investigate or gather data, especially in space exploration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火星|かせい}→火星：13412_kasei⟧{探査機|たんさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{探査機|たんさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧きた⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Images sent back by the probe were released to the public.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小惑星|しょうわくせい}→小惑星：05244_shouwakusei⟧{探査機|たんさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦サンプル→サンプル：10939_sanpuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}る→持ち帰る：04227_mochikaeru⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。
examples.english: Japan's asteroid probe succeeded in bringing samples back to Earth.

notes:
⟦{探査|たんさ}→探査：05325_tansa⟧ (exploration, probing) + ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine, device). Most commonly used in the context of space exploration to refer to unmanned spacecraft. Can also refer to deep-sea probes or other remote exploration devices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{惑星|わくせい}→惑星：05052_wakusei⟧{探査機|たんさき} — planetary probe
- ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧{探査機|たんさき} — lunar probe
- ⟦{小惑星|しょうわくせい}→小惑星：05244_shouwakusei⟧{探査機|たんさき} — asteroid probe
- ⟦{深海|しんかい}→深海：16050_shinkai⟧{探査機|たんさき} — deep-sea probe
- ⟦{無人|むじん}→無人：13388_mujin⟧{探査機|たんさき} — unmanned probe

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's はやぶさ (Hayabusa) asteroid probe became a national sensation when it returned samples from the asteroid Itokawa in 2010. Its successor, {はやぶさ2|はやぶさに}, completed a similar mission to asteroid Ryugu in 2020.
